lines.explanation: This is a preprocessor command. System header file stdio.h will be   inserted there during compilationWe include stdio.h header file because it contains function   prototypes for getchar and putchar and a definition of symbolic   constant EOF
This is the start of main function definition. Every program should   have function main
c is defined as integer because getchar function can return EOF - an   integer value that is outside of the range of char values
This is call pre-reading. The first symbol is read before we enter   while loop since c has to have a value before we enter while loop.
This is the header of while loop. The loop works while condition in   brackets is true
Character stored in variable c is placed to the standard output
New character is read from the standard input. The characted assigned   to variable c.
This bracket closes definition function main.
